quote.text: Just as it matters little whether you lay a sick man on a wooden or on a golden bed, for whithersoever he be moved he will carry his malady with him; so one need not care whether the diseased mind is bestowed upon riches or upon poverty. His malady goes with the man. Farewell,
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the inherent nature of a child's disposition persists regardless of the external comforts or material wealth provided; nurture their inner character through consistent guidance and love.
    • Focus on cultivating virtues such as resilience and wisdom in your children, understanding that no luxurious setting can cure what lies within—a troubled spirit must be mended with thoughtful care.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership is not about the trappings of power or the golden accolades, but in the ability to recognize that the core challenges of the mind require honest reflection and principled action.
    • Embrace the responsibility to address internal shortcomings—both in yourself and in those you lead—by fostering environments of integrity where even the deepest maladies can be confronted and healed.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, understand that superficial enhancements or lavish features cannot mask underlying issues; the inherent value and quality of the product must be addressed directly.
    • Prioritize solving core problems and refining the essential attributes of your product, as neglecting the fundamental flaws will always carry forward despite aesthetic improvements.
